mentions.name: Discover Indie Tools
mentions.description: A directory of apps and tools built by indie makers, limited to bootstrapped products from indie hackers and small teams (no VC or angel-backed startups). It gives indie creators a space to showcase their apps and helps early adopters discover alternatives to major players.
mentions.audience: Indie creators showcasing their apps and early adopters looking for alternatives to major players
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a directory of apps and tools created by indie makers: https://www.discoverindie.tools.

Only bootstrapped products by indie hackers and small teams. No VC/Angel backed startups.

mentions.name: Discover Indie Tools
mentions.description: A directory of apps and tools created by indie makers and small teams, limited to fully bootstrapped products. It gives founders a space to showcase their products and lets early adopters and the general public browse through bootstrapped alternatives.
mentions.audience: Founders showcasing their bootstrapped products; early adopters and the general public browsing bootstrapped alternatives.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm currently working on a directory of apps and tools, created by indie makers and small teams: https://www.discoverindie.tools.

Only indie make products, fully bootstrapped.

The idea is to both give founders another space to showcase their products and for early adopters and general public to browse through bootstrapped alternatives.
